decisions.reason: Although it was close to our core knowledge base, its disappearance from the website after launch signals weak traction or insufficient differentiation in a broad portfolio, so absorptive capacity is better used on stronger lines.
This handle family stayed on the website beyond launch and fits our established design, engineering and certification knowledge, giving us strong ability to refine and commercialize it further.

Its continued presence after launch suggests usable market acceptance, and because it builds directly on our existing ergonomic and design competences we can keep learning from and improving it efficiently.
Despite being related to our existing offer, it vanished quickly from the website, which indicates that the early market feedback did not justify continued resource allocation.
The product family was removed after the launch year, implying limited commercial promise relative to other nearby products where our absorptive capacity can be applied more effectively.

The electronic access system remained on the website with an updated Pro positioning and matches our strategic move toward digital building organization, where our in-house R&D and system know-how support continued improvement.
